commonPrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one original square 1024 by 1024 app avatar PNG, a professional fictional AI expert portrait. Create ONLY ONE portrait, never a contact sheet. Coherent series style: refined contemporary editorial illustration with tactile painted shading and crisp deliberate silhouette, human character and subtle personality, grown-up and professional rather than stock corporate clipart, not photographic. Composition: centered head and shoulders, face large and immediately readable at 48 pixels, generous safe margin around hair, clean simple backdrop, restrained studio lighting, thoughtful approachable gaze and slight natural asymmetry. Clothing contemporary professional casual with interesting but minimal tailoring, no suit-and-tie cliche. No letters, text, badges, symbols, logos, watermarks, decorative UI or frame; no references to any existing avatar, company mascot or real person. Do not use any user-supplied image as reference.
